description: This file defines models and logic for managing employee attendance, including sign-in/sign-out actions, action reasons, and attendance state calculations within an Odoo (OpenERP) module.

classes.name: hr_action_reason
classes.description: Model representing reasons for actions such as sign-in or sign-out.

classes.name: hr_attendance
classes.description: Model representing employee attendance records, including sign-in and sign-out actions.

classes.name: hr_employee
classes.description: Extension of the hr.employee model to include attendance state and sign-in/sign-out methods.

methods.name: _employee_get
methods.description: Retrieves the employee ID associated with the current user.

methods.name: _state
methods.description: Computes the current attendance state ('present' or 'absent') for employees based on latest attendance record.

methods.name: sign_change
methods.description: Records a sign-in or sign-out action for an employee at a specified date/time.

methods.name: sign_out
methods.description: Records a sign-out action for an employee at a specified date/time.

methods.name: sign_in
methods.description: Records a sign-in action for an employee at a specified date/time.

methods.name: _action_check
methods.description: Checks if the new attendance action's date is valid (not earlier than the last recorded action).
